body:
'k-pins'
This is a Live trip report it is now 8:34 pm. Pill was ingested at aprox 8:30 pm. Backround: I've done X, shrooms, acid, weed, speed, opiates, uppers, alot. Anyway I am in a fairly good mood at this time and I will update every 15 mins starting in 15 minutes.
(8:45)- wow its that time already ..well. Not feeling anything so its obviously not fast-acting.
(9:00)-nothing more noticible talking to some girls on msn ;) and havin a fun time. But no noticible effects yet besides a very slight relaxation barely noticible.
(9:15)-nothing thats directly noticible. Harder to type a bit and concentration is slowly declining.
(9:30)-Ok I'm completely under the infuence. Kind of like a Dissociation type feel, with a drunken feel , but without the nausea and dizziness. Think seem to move slower then normal. And I want to lie in bed with my gf.
(9:45)-Effects are increasing dramaticaly in the last 15 minutes. All the effects from 9:30 are like amplified. Coordination is completely lost. I move my head towards the screen and I feel like I'm going to fall off a sky skraper literlly. Kind feel like I'm at the peak!!.
(10:00)-peaked out for sure. Feeling all the previous effects at a comfortable level. Ima go lie down with my gf and sleep a good night.
Conclusion. Lasts a bit long, very good sleep aid. Nice for chillin wit friends.
